objective: Propose September's target: write targets/2026-09-30.json in the shape of targets/2026-08-31.json — the weight of each ETF the portfolio holds, and the band — feasible under benchmark.json's subsets and tolerances.
contribution: The one judgment of the close, bounded: the target the rebalance is planned against. Its feasibility is the host's run of the portfolio's checks, not the unit's claim.

fixed.subject: the universe
fixed.decision: A target names only tickers universe.json names; the universe and its exchangeable sets are not extended by a unit.

fixed.subject: the benchmark subsets
fixed.decision: Each subset of benchmark.json stays within its tolerance of the benchmark's weight for it; benchmark.json is not edited.

fixed.subject: the constraint classes
fixed.decision: The target is long-only and its weights sum to one.

fixed.subject: the band
fixed.decision: The target carries the band 0.02: the maximum deviation from the target any position lands at after a rebalance, as a fraction of the portfolio's value.

delegated.subject: the expected-return inputs
delegated.bounds: No view has been raised this period, so the inputs are the benchmark's own weights read as the equilibrium; a tilt from them stays inside every subset's tolerance. Report the inputs used and the reason for any tilt.

expectedEvidence.description: run_tests: the portfolio's own suite passes at the committed revision — the target is long-only, sums to one, names only the universe, and holds each benchmark subset within its tolerance
run_checks: the static checks pass and the protected prefixes are untouched
